# Project instructions

- Build this project as a Playwright JavaScript automation suite for SauceDemo.
- Use ES modules and a page object model for maintainable code.
- Keep test data in environment variables and .env.example files.
- Validate key user journeys for login, inventory, cart, checkout, and logout.
- Generate HTML, screenshot, trace, and video artifacts for failures.
- Keep tests independent so they can run individually or in parallel.
